content.short: Offramp is a self-custodial global account for freelancers to get paid in dollars or euros and spend anywhere.
content.description: Offramp gives freelancers, remote workers and digital nomads a global account built on stablecoins instead of a traditional bank. Users get their own USD details for ACH and EUR details for SEPA, which they can share with clients or connect to platforms such as Deel, Upwork, Fiverr and Wise. Money arrives as digital dollars, so balances keep their value in countries where the local currency loses ground. Spending runs through an international Visa card with no issuance fee, or through QR and Pix payments in Latin America, and deposits work from seven networks including Ethereum, Base and Solana.
content.meta: Offramp is a self-custodial global account for freelancers paid in USD or EUR stablecoins. Discover Offramp and other Neobanks on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
